“ In all ages, when a heathen was willing to enter into the covenant of Israel, and gather himself under the wings of the majesty of God, and take upon himself the yoke of the law, he must be first circumcised; ,and secondly, baptized ; and thirdly, bring a sacrifice: or, if the party were a woman, then she must be first baptized; and secondly, bring a sacrifice.”

‘‘And it came to pass, when Joshua waa by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, there stood a man over against him, with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Ait thou for us, or for our adversaries?
